description: Icons for the curated dungeon's HUD, boss panel, toasts and result card (잊혀진 지하 유적). They replace the text glyphs and badge words of today's screens and add a symbol where a line reads faster with one. One set: every item follows the same style and is tinted by the widget.
style: Flat single-color game UI glyph: a pure white (#FFFFFF) silhouette on a fully transparent background. Bold shapes that read at 20 pixels: strokes about a twelfth of the icon's width, rounded ends and joins, no hairlines, no detail smaller than a stroke. No gradients, outlines, shadows, glow, perspective, text, letters, logos or watermarks. Centered and optically balanced inside the padding. Old stone ruins guarded by an electric beast: stone and rune shapes for places, a jagged lightning spark only on the guardian's own icons. See Art/Style/ui_style.md.
